value.markup:
The still house is open Tuesday to Saturday. Tours run at 11.00 and 14.00 and finish in the warehouse with three drams, including whatever is in the cask we are filling.

Opening hours

  • Tuesday to Friday: 10.00–17.00
  • Saturday: 10.00–16.00
  • Sunday and Monday: closed

Dogs are welcome in the yard. The warehouse floor is uneven; tell us in advance if that is a problem and we will take the tour another way round.

values.value: Tours at 11.00 and 14.00, Tuesday to Saturday, finishing in the warehouse.
